name: hud_ui_zrd_widget_get_bounds_rect_or_null
description: HudUiZrdWidget::GetBoundsRectOrNull returns null when disabled and otherwise updates cached bounds from the active image or label-panel text extents.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiZrdWidget source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja still renders the text-alignment switch as interleaved branches; centered bounds retain the compiler signed-half-width cdq/sar idiom.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b5350 validates the disabled null return, image bounds path, label-panel begin null return, label height accumulation, left/center/right alignment cases, dirty text rebuild dispatch through ftable slot 36/offset 0x90, and final cached boundsRect return.
Native smoke zhud_zrd_widget_helpers_smoke verifies disabled and image paths plus left, centered, and right-aligned label bounds using HudUiPanel::QueryTextHeight and cached text width/height fields.
